abstract:
BACKGROUND: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) ranks among the deadliest malignancies, with limited survival benefits despite recent therapeutic advances. Few prognostic biomarkers are available for PDAC monitoring in clinical practice. We conducted a meta-analysis to evaluate and synthesise evidence on the prognostic significance of miRNA expression in PDAC.
METHODS: The protocol was registered with PROSPERO (CRD42023463542). We conducted a systematic search in PubMed, CENTRAL, and Embase on January 27, 2026, to identify studies assessing miRNA expression levels in patients with PDAC with reported overall survival (OS) or progression-free survival (PFS) outcomes. Hazard ratios (HRs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were pooled using a random-effects model. Prediction intervals (PI) were reported if feasible. Separate analyses were performed by miRNA functional categories: oncogenic, tumour suppressor, chemoresistance-related, metastasis-related, and dual-role miRNAs.
FINDINGS: A total of 142 studies, including 13,824 patients, were included. High expression of oncogenic miRNAs was associated with worse univariate OS (HR 1.70, 95% CI 1.38-2.10; 95% PI 0.63-4.57) and PFS (HR 2.25, 95% CI 1.63-3.10; 95% PI 1.11-4.55). High expression of chemoresistance-related miRNAs was associated with worse multivariate OS (HR 2.11, 95% CI 1.68-2.66; 95% PI 0.96-4.68) and PFS (HR 2.51, 95% CI 1.89-3.33; 95% PI 1.58-3.97). Between-study heterogeneity varied substantially across pooled analyses (I2 range 0-94%). miRNA-21 was the most frequently studied individual biomarker and showed a consistent association with worse multivariate OS (HR 2.24, 95% CI 1.95-2.57; 95% PI 1.92-2.61).
INTERPRETATION: Elevated expression of oncogenic and chemoresistance-related miRNAs is associated with worse survival outcomes in PDAC. However, substantial heterogeneity and wide prediction intervals observed in several pooled analyses indicate variability in effect sizes across studies. Among the investigated biomarkers, miRNA-21 has shown the most consistent prognostic association and may represent the strongest candidate for future clinical implementation. Further validation and standardisation are required before miRNA profiling can be integrated into routine clinical practice.
FUNDING: None to declare.
key_points_ko: 총 142개 연구의 췌관선암 환자 13,824명을 대상으로 miRNA의 예후적 가치를 체계적으로 분석했습니다.
발암성 miRNA의 높은 발현은 전체 생존기간 악화(위험비 1.70) 및 무진행 생존기간 악화(위험비 2.25)와 관련이 있었습니다.
항암제 내성 관련 miRNA의 높은 발현 역시 불량한 전체 생존기간(위험비 2.11) 및 무진행 생존기간(위험비 2.51)과 연관되었습니다.
가장 빈번하게 분석된 miRNA-21은 다변량 전체 생존기간 악화(위험비 2.24)와 일관된 연관성을 보여 향후 임상 도입 가능성이 가장 높은 표지자로 제시되었습니다.
summary_ko: 췌관선암(PDAC) 환자에서 마이크로RNA(miRNA) 발현 수준이 생존기간에 미치는 영향을 평가하기 위해 142개 연구, 총 13,824명의 데이터를 종합 분석했습니다. 분석 결과 발암성 및 항암제 내성 관련 miRNA가 높게 발현될수록 전체 생존기간(OS)과 무진행 생존기간(PFS)이 유의미하게 단축되었습니다. 특히 miRNA-21은 불량한 생존 예후와 가장 일관된 연관성을 보였습니다. 연구 간 이질성이 존재하여 임상 현장에서의 실제 적용을 위해서는 추가 검증과 표준화 작업이 필요합니다.
title: Prognostic value of microRNA expression in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma: a systematic review and meta-analysis
